name: Paradise Power Company, Inc | PPC Solar
old_description: Paradise Power Company, Inc. (PPC Solar) was initially founded out of need for solar technology to sustain the off-grid lifestyle prevalent in northern New Mexico. With our roots starting in off-grid solar, PPC has over 45 years of expertise in the customization of off-grid and energy storage systems.
about:
Paradise Power Company, Inc. (PPC Solar) was founded in 1979 by Michael Weinman in Taos, New Mexico, to meet the demand for solar technology supporting the off-grid lifestyle common in northern New Mexico. The family-owned business passed to his son, Daniel Weinman, in 1993, and remains locally operated with headquarters in Taos and a fully staffed office and warehouse in Albuquerque.

The company provides turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction of solar photovoltaic, battery energy storage, and electric vehicle charging systems for residential, commercial, school, government, and utility clients. Since its founding, PPC has installed more than 30 megawatts of photovoltaic capacity and over 200 EV charging stations across New Mexico and Colorado, managing projects from design through long-term maintenance.

Customers include the Northern New Mexico School Employees Federal Credit Union in Santa Fe, Taos Mountain Builders, San Miguel County, Bartee Ranch, Angel Fire Family Dentistry, Eastern New Mexico University, and state agencies such as the New Mexico General Services Department and the New Mexico Department of Transportation. The firm also serves commercial clients like Taos Spa and Siemens.

PPC emphasizes its 45-plus years of continuous local presence, which has built strong relationships with inspectors, utilities, and vendors. The company backs its work with 10- and 25-year warranties and differentiates itself by keeping all project phases—design, procurement, installation, and service—under one roof.
